SELECT
    sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) AS actual_sales,
    sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 3) AS forecast_sales,
    forecast_sales - actual_sales AS variance_amount,
    (forecast_sales - actual_sales) * 100.0 / nullIf(actual_sales, 0) AS variance_pct,
    100.0 - (abs(forecast_sales - actual_sales) * 100.0 / nullIf(actual_sales, 0)) AS forecast_accuracy_pct
FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan AS sp
INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
    ON sp.DateKey = d.DateKey
WHERE sp.AccountKey = 50
  AND sp.ScenarioKey IN (1, 3)
  AND d.CalendarYear = 2009
  AND d.CalendarQuarterLabel = 'Q4'
